summary: Jenkinsfile.iac-scheduled-certs now renews the internal_tls leaves in the same job and Friday slot as the SSH host certs: four stages (host certs prd/dev, then TLS leaves prd/dev), prd untimed and reddening the build, dev probed with devUp() and only ever UNSTABLE (page only on a genuine failure). The shared post block was made truthful for two classes — each prd stage writes its own failure description via a stage-level post block, and both dev stages feed the existing DEV_STAGE_FAILED page gate. kc project test is green; no Groovy parser exists here, so the pipeline syntax is reviewed, not machine-checked.
